head.title: fix(caj): validate redundant framing before omitting interruptions

review.resolved_finding: An initial fixed stream-tail bound used a LimitExceeded error and prevented independently proved replay recovery when a bad extent landed in whitespace payload. The final code keeps the 64-byte bound but reports a framing mismatch, preserving resource-budget errors and recovery proof. Existing JS controls and an expanded original Rust replay control pass.
review.simplification: Keep framing recognition separate from final reference proof. Reuse existing reader, candidate confirmation, deferred prefix handling and writer. Shared prefix/header comparison helpers perform both discovery and source rechecks. No new public API, codec, dependency or whole-input buffer.

limitations: Vendor viewing covers pages 1–3 at 50 percent; independent verbatim-body PDF framing and Poppler cover all 60 pages.
Tool agreement is not an assertion of implementation independence between rendering libraries.
Full native corpus execution is recorded separately from the two-input Node/Chromium run. Existing ancillary failures and NOT_RUN states remain in the ledger.
The new NH source-viewer pixels remain NOT_RUN; CAA descriptors contain no embedded pages and their opaque values were not decoded or resolved.
This change neither resolves all remaining #406 samples nor proves every remaining refusal impossible. No release is performed.
provenance: Original MIT Rust, fixtures and measurement metadata only. No external CAJ/PDF, document text, font/pixel data, vendor binaries, credentials or foreign converter implementation are committed.
